rankSignals.label: Provenance
rankSignals.blurb: Source tier and evidence. A coach-observed note with a link outranks an unverified hunch with none.

rankSignals.label: Adoption
rankSignals.blurb: How many other pitchers independently tried the same tweak. Real replication, not passive clicks.

rankSignals.label: Usefulness
rankSignals.blurb: Marked useful, measured against views so a small loud crowd cannot stuff the rank.

rankSignals.label: Context match
rankSignals.blurb: How close a note is to your level, slot, and pace context. Computed in your session, never stored.

rankSignals.label: Community confidence
rankSignals.blurb: Considered practice: a real sample size behind the claim, not one good bullpen.
